title: Word Play
intro: Letters can be shuffled, hidden, dropped and swapped. See what you can spot.

teasers.question: Rearrange the letters of the word listen to make a word that means making no sound.
teasers.hint: It also starts with an s.
teasers.explanation: Listen and silent use exactly the same six letters in a different order.

teasers.question: A word for a home for horses becomes a piece of furniture if you drop its first letter. Which word is it?
teasers.hint: The furniture has a flat top and legs.
teasers.explanation: Taking the s from stable leaves table.

teasers.question: A fish is hiding at the start of the word carpet. Which fish?
teasers.explanation: The first four letters of carpet spell carp, a freshwater fish.

teasers.question: Which four-letter word for midday reads the same backwards as forwards?
teasers.hint: It has two pairs of letters that mirror each other.
teasers.explanation: Noon is a palindrome: n, o, o, n reads the same in both directions.

teasers.question: Change one letter at a time to turn dark into dawn, making a real word at every step. What is the fewest number of steps?
teasers.hint: The middle word is something you might do to a sock.
teasers.explanation: Dark becomes darn by changing k to n, and darn becomes dawn by changing r to w. Every word along the way is real.

teasers.question: Which job title for someone who keeps the accounts has three pairs of double letters in a row?
teasers.hint: The words book and keeper are joined together.
teasers.explanation: Bookkeeper has oo, kk and ee one after another.

teasers.question: Take the first letter off stone and you get a sound quality. Take the first letter off that and you get a number. Which number?
teasers.hint: Say the shorter words out loud.
teasers.explanation: Stone loses its s to become tone, and tone loses its t to become one.

teasers.question: Which word can follow sun, moon and star to name what each one gives out?
teasers.hint: Think of what all three give out.
teasers.explanation: Sunlight, moonlight and starlight all work, and light is what each one gives out.

teasers.question: Which word for feeling under pressure becomes a sweet end to a meal when you read it backwards?
teasers.explanation: Reading the letters of stressed from the end gives desserts.
